name: main
_comment: The client in the session you are sitting in. Empty user = whoever is logged on here. This file is optional — without it tools/lib/instance_manager.py uses exactly this pair. Copy it to instances.json to add a third account.

name: casper
_comment: A client in its own Windows session, brought up by tools/rdp_instance.py --user casper --port 47655 (or by hand with tools/start_instance.cmd 47655 from inside that session). One port per instance; the daemon of each attaches to the client of its own session.
